description: srp's own classes of the lobby movie: each is owned whole by srp (any of its methods, fields and declarations may change or grow). A new one names abc_with, a class of the release whose ABC takes it (FFDec compiles it there, after that ABC's records), in this order. "removed": srp's classes of the release gone from the tree (their code is in the game's classes now); the build takes them out of the movie.
